content.title: Captured preparation and actual scope history require distinct receipts
content.text: Source-grounded applicability corrections against checked owner6399 / checkpointcae9462b. Main runWithChild uses SelectedPreparation.run: Entry.enter decoded and SelectedValue may unfold Mu/expose Union into prepared node. Prepared ordinary does not imply decoded ordinary; use original packet_restart_ne for captured uv≠held, and keep the actual decoded/prepared relation. Also ActualFrameLedger.captured quantifies a separate resource scopeBefore; frame identity contains only edge/residual/caller/queries. ActualSourceOrigin alone does not identify the independently supplied scope in Current. Do not infer R root.before→scopeBefore by ledger inversion. Carry a concrete PAST history/avoidance receipt on the ACTUALLY generated ledger, recursively retaining selected parent receipts; derive it at real captured/selected entry and restore it at return. This is internal data, never a new external906 premise or future outputOK supplier. Existing TupleInputs local proof at owner21705–21723 already gives the direct before→middle history needed for selected entry. New induction drafts remain unpromoted; original906 and one joint finite historical model remain OPEN. No Haskell defect/change or actual-source counterexample is claimed.
